source_and_access: The official [DCAS surplus-sales guide](https://www.nyc.gov/site/dcas/business/surplus-sales.page) points to the GovDeals seller page but publishes no item-level export. The official [DCAS Vehicle Auction List](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/ynic-uz5i) supplies the fleet subset through Socrata. GovDeals' User Agreement section 2 prohibits spiders, crawlers, robots, substantial downloading, and data mining; its API page says access is for registered GovDeals clients.
join_feasibility: **Measured:** the fleet dataset contains 12,316 rows and the bounded 90-day snapshot found no open rows as of 2026-08-04. NYC Open Data searches found no equivalent non-fleet item feed. Non-fleet coverage is **unknown; no numeric claim is made**.
reader_value: **3** — Property commercial-watch readers can find vehicles and, if an authorized feed becomes available, other surplus goods without confusing them with parcel dispositions.
disposition: **Split disposition:** the official fleet subset landed as a basis-labeled goods-surplus facet. Non-fleet stays a DCAS/GovDeals authorized-export or client-API request; no marketplace scraper.
